name: Oklahoma
status_why: The results site refuses scripts; John saves its two Export files by hand.
approval_note: John said yes (2026-10-10, D3): he saves the two Export files on the night.
system: State Election Board's results site OKER (results.okelections.us, AWS load balancer); exports <date>_StateResults.csv and <date>_CountyResults_csv.zip from its Export menu.

election.how_to_find: The site keys elections by date.

hand.how: John uses the site's own Export menu in his browser and saves both files into the folder; the updater reads the newest copy. A figure's time is the file's own time, or else when he saved it.

feeds.address: https://results.okelections.us/OKER/?elecDate=<yyyymmdd>; exports <yyyymmdd>_StateResults.csv (one row per candidate per contest) and <yyyymmdd>_CountyResults_csv.zip
feeds.updates: through election night as counties report
feeds.note: HTTP 403 (awselb/2.0) on 2026-10-09 for ?elecDate=20260825. results.okelections.gov also answered 403 (awselb/2.0); CLAUDE.md records it earlier failing to resolve.

precinct_level: unknown (county file seen; precinct export not confirmed)
races_in_feed: some local and school (the list prints only contested races)
local: Mostly no: county election boards report into the state system. Oklahoma County and Tulsa County election boards post their own notices (not requested).
how_counted: County election boards report to the State Election Board through the night.
count_order: OKER is known to show early, absentee and Election Day columns (not seen from here).
vote_types: Unknown; OKER is known to show early, absentee and election-day columns but this was not seen from here.

certify.rule: After 5 p.m. on the Tuesday after the election (Okla. Stat. tit. 26, 7-136).
certify.local_rule: County boards after 5 p.m. on the Friday after (7-136).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

never_why.results.okelections.us: 403 to scripts at the load balancer (scout, 2026-10-09)
never_why.results.okelections.gov: 403 to scripts at the load balancer (scout, 2026-10-09)

rehearsal: The June 16 primary and Aug 25 runoff exports in ballot_cache/ok/results/<yyyymmdd>/
scout_blocked: 403 to scripts at the AWS load balancer on both results.okelections.us and results.okelections.gov.
scout_plan: Treat like Minnesota: John uses the site's own Export menu in his browser on election night and saves the two files into a watched folder (ballot_cache/ok/results/20261103/); the updater reads the newest copy and publishes. The column layout is already known from the primary exports, so the reader is mostly written.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
